summary: npm package used as CDN vehicle for browser-side iframe redirect
details: px8my ships px.js, a browser-context script that constructs a full-screen iframe pointing at https://mfmz.piolzo.cn/H.html and appends it to the current document. The file uses document.write / document.createElement / iframe DOM APIs and throws if required in Node. The package.json declares no preinstall, install, postinstall, or prepare lifecycle scripts, and the module performs no filesystem access, credential reads, or network I/O when installed or required. The apparent distribution model is loading px.js through a public npm CDN mirror (e.g. jsDelivr) and embedding it into third-party web pages; the impacted parties are end-users of those pages, not developers who run npm install on this package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
